claude_proposed_widenings.name: shed_light
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The robe emits Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet while active. No v4 atom covers light emission from a creature or item. This is not cosmetic: the bright-light radius defines the zone of effect for the Wis save, and the light source determines which creatures can meet the 'can see you' visibility condition that gates both the save and the disadvantage. The effect is mechanically load-bearing, not narrative.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: the robe sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet

claude_proposed_widenings.name: visibility_filter on modify_roll_advantage and save_gate area
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Both the disadvantage rider and the save_gate are conditioned on 'creatures that can see you'. The surface has attackerTypeFilter (creature type) on modify_roll_advantage but no visibility filter. Similarly, area-targeted save_gate phases have no filter for line-of-sight or visibility. Without this filter, encoding applies the effects to all attackers/area creatures unconditionally, which contradicts the rule. A new variant (e.g., { kind: 'can_see_target' }) on both modify_roll_advantage and on area-phase targeting is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: creatures that can see you have Disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Any creature in the Bright Light that can see you when the robe's power is activated must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom saving throw
